notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l003: каркыбар is a laudatory epithet for a powerful hero, not established here as a separate personal name. https://el-sozduk.kg/карк/
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l005: керик/rhinoceros and бил/elephant retained as epic animals, not asserted historical military equipment; same readings p176:l017 and p184:l005.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l014: байдадан is unresolved. From every place men could come from is a provisional contextual rendering; possibly a defective form of пайда or жай. Raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l018: Forty rope-lengths retained without conversion; deep is supplied from pit, not a recovered additional word.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l023: Ажайыпка алдырган is an awkward fragment; wondrously provided for is provisional, not a reconstructed clause.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l028: Айт! retained as Ayt!, an attack/order cry in this setting; literal lexical sense say/tell may also be relevant.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l029: Seventy executioners retained despite forty at l019; no harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l041: Баашалыктай interpreted like an emperor/padishah, as the analogous earlier feast passage.
notes.manas-2010:p0165:b002:l042: Жинди literally Madman is the concealing nickname; retained as translated nickname, not Manas substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p0166:b002:l008: Forelocks reduced to loose wool preserves the violent literal image, possibly an idiom of humiliation.
notes.manas-2010:p0166:b002:l010: кочку is a Kalmyk headman title, plural here; Kochku also occurs as the individual name/title. https://el-sozduk.kg/кочку/
notes.manas-2010:p0166:b002:l019: Жалаяк ооз broad mouth and жар кабак cliff-like brows are provisional descriptive epithets.
notes.manas-2010:p0166:b002:l029: талкан flour/ground roasted grain: grinding simile preserved, not a literal measurement.
notes.manas-2010:p0166:b002:l040: бут interpreted as idol in the religious-epic context; foot/leg is an alternate lexical possibility. No raw emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0166:b002:l046: Комокойлуу tentatively socketed/hollow-throated; exact spear fitting uncertain. сыр is lacquered/painted, not secret.
notes.manas-2010:p0167:b002:l004: бил мүчөлүү interpreted elephant-limbed; бадирек formidable brute. Exact epithet nuance uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0167:b002:l005: себилдүү means equipped/armed; eighty-four retained without deciding whether it counts equipment or companions. https://el-sozduk.kg/себил/
notes.manas-2010:p0167:b002:l014: Bakburchun, Kakanchyn and Dyngshang retained; personal/title/place distinctions and historical geography not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0167:b002:l020: тоонун теңиндей rendered half a mountain; like/equal to a mountain is another possible construction. Hyperbolic scale is certain; exact fraction uncertain. Same p172:l016 and p173:l027.
notes.manas-2010:p0167:b002:l036: Казып көрдү ойгону is visibly awkward. Digging/hollowing is retained, earth supplied as an implicit object. Possible көр/гөр grave reading is not silently inserted; wording unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0168:b004:l003: Boroonchu appears without a complete independent clause. Preserved as a named fragment; not omitted or assigned a new speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0168:b004:l008: Mankushta and Mangkush at p173:l041 may be variant spellings or distinct forms; no identity claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0168:b004:l019: Ay-Jangjung and Kün-Jangjung retain name/title compounds (moon/sun + military title); not treated as literal celestial bodies.
notes.manas-2010:p0168:b004:l027: учмактуу tentatively splendid/blessed (related to paradise); exact sense uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0168:b004:l031: The champion is said to be slaughtered before subsequent speeches. Source sequence preserved; no assumed chronological repair.
notes.manas-2010:p0169:b002:l003: алты айчылык may indicate six months of journey-distance rather than prediction six months into the future; six months away preserves some ambiguity.
notes.manas-2010:p0169:b002:l007: Six months hence is a provisional temporal interpretation; a six-month journey-distance reading is possible.
notes.manas-2010:p0169:b002:l013: Кара күчкө literally by sheer force/effort; merely claimed represents the accusation of a forced/fabricated answer, exact nuance provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0169:b002:l028: Speech attribution is not explicit: Döngö is introduced, but ensuing first-person accusations resemble Esenkan. No new speaker label inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0169:b002:l029: отогот is a jeweled rank badge on headgear per Yudakhin, not itself body armor. The next collar/sleeve lines imply an unnamed garment; kept as an elliptical sequence. https://el-sozduk.kg/отогот/
notes.manas-2010:p0170:b002:l008: сүрүнөтү interpreted as defective сүннөтү in circumcision description. Foreskin supplied to express the allusion; no source correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0170:b002:l009: бышмана can mean distress/dismay in the 2015 explanatory dictionary; the appearance passage may have a defective different word. Dismay rendering provisional. https://el-sozduk.kg/бышмана/
notes.manas-2010:p0170:b002:l011: Prophet-like ... бышмана is semantically awkward. Dismay follows the documented lexical sense but whole phrase remains unresolved; do not certify this interpretation.
notes.manas-2010:p0170:b002:l017: Бараадан from afar/distance tentatively; exact phrase unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p0170:b002:l046: Full reckoning is idiomatic contextual interpretation of чын эсебин таптырды in the execution scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0171:b002:l009: Чогол tentatively short/compact as gun epithet; precise weapon subtype not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0171:b002:l021: даңгыт is a grown male dog/wolf; dog rendering selected. Dictionary cites a closely parallel road-and-carcass line. https://el-sozduk.kg/ДАҢГЫТ/
notes.manas-2010:p0171:b002:l028: Non-graphic translation of the captor’s coercive reproductive threat; айгыр stallion/stud metaphor retained, not endorsed or expanded.
notes.manas-2010:p0171:b002:l031: Амыз likely defective намыс; without reproach is provisional. Source left unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0171:b002:l037: карыпчын/карыпчы is battle arm armor, not a coffin. https://el-sozduk.kg/КАРЫПЧЫ/ Same p173:l019 and p183:l013.
notes.manas-2010:p0171:b002:l046: Эр уулу may mean a grown male/warrior rather than literally a warrior’s son; literal construction retained. Same p172:l001.
notes.manas-2010:p0172:b002:l010: Тобу force/host is tentative; no specific artillery equipment inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0172:b002:l011: Iskender retained as epic name, associated with Alexander; narrator’s claim about Beejin is not verified history.
notes.manas-2010:p0172:b002:l036: All sorcerers versus earlier exactly forty preserved; not a new count reconciliation.
notes.manas-2010:p0173:b002:l003: жутунуп implies eager/greedy lunging; devouringly preserves the predatory image, not actual cannibalism asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0173:b002:l013: Fragmented migration syntax retained; us men of Beejin is contextual subject of бузган.
notes.manas-2010:p0173:b002:l019: калдай retained kaldai, an official/title epithet; arm armor reading verified separately.
notes.manas-2010:p0173:b002:l035: дөң hill retained literally; possible дөө giant corruption remains uncorrected.
notes.manas-2010:p0173:b002:l043: Karager retained as horse name/color appellation; no identification beyond the text.
notes.manas-2010:p0173:b002:l048: Анча-мынча some/a few tentatively lesser stature in this boast; precise quantitative/dismissive force uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0174:b002:l005: кадуу mountain slope supported by Yudakhin; house-on-slope metaphor retained. https://el-sozduk.kg/к/
notes.manas-2010:p0174:b002:l008: batman is a historical variable weight measure; seven/eight retained, no kilogram conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p0174:b002:l024: Бай байлаган белимсиң difficult support/waist metaphor. Firmly bound support is provisional, no raw emendation.
notes.manas-2010:p0174:b002:l029: Супа-садык is the true-dawn formula (subh-i sadiq); not a named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0174:b002:l031: түмөн rendered countless; no multiplication by seven or inferred exact troop count. p177 explicitly states ten thousand.
notes.manas-2010:p0174:b002:l039: Kill him retained despite adjacent demand to bind Manas alive. No harmonization of conflicting instructions.
notes.manas-2010:p0175:b002:l002: башын third-person form rendered your head from address/context; possible ң/н defect. Same contextual person adjustment мойнуна at l012. Raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0175:b002:l013: Дарыгерге is visibly physician/healer (dictionary verified), absurd in hanging/execution context. Literal physician retained; possible дарга gallows corruption is NOT silently substituted. https://el-sozduk.kg/Дар/
notes.manas-2010:p0175:b002:l037: Кынжы with cords/straps provisional; subject and attachment to the following warrior list uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0175:b002:l042: Orko and Kerke transliterated without identification or conflation with other champions.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l002: Iron-rope net inferred from торчону; exact word form uncertain; no modern device terminology introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l005: колчону interpreted hand-equipped/armed; literal all with daggers in hands tentative.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l022: Чылаба retained Chylaba as title/epithet before Esenkan; exact meaning unresolved.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l028: жолум үй is a small temporary traveling dwelling; tent selected for the size simile, no exact dimensions.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l036: Heads knocking together retained in marching crowd; not silently rewritten as decapitations.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l039: Торала is bay/brown-variegated; unusual banner color retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0176:b002:l043: Ачбуудан retained Achbuudan; no correction to another horse name.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l004: Visible кек treated contextually as defective көк, supported by following line. Translation blue-grey noted; raw unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l006: Кары бою буладан is uncertain armor construction. kary retained as a traditional length measure, була fiber; exact material and arrangement not established.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l011: Көрсө куба кандырган visibly opaque. Satisfied the eye is a provisional contextual rendering, not a verified lexical reading.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l023: чыңыроо interpreted shrill musical instrument/sound, exact instrument unidentified.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l025: ороктоп literally sickling/circling; wheeling about chosen as movement of captains.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l033: Өлгөн literally dead interpreted as narrator’s hostile doomed epithet, not claiming dead men are marching.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l038: Алеңгир bow epithet provisionally mighty; no verified material or construction asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0177:b002:l043: карысы their elder applied to Döngö; no age supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p0178:b002:l009: Тоңурайган коо steep ravine interpretation tentative; terrain terms visibly retained in source.
notes.manas-2010:p0178:b002:l019: Three months of rest retained, not silently shortened to days.
notes.manas-2010:p0178:b002:l028: I supplied before Khan Joloy to make the self-introduction syntactically legible; speech continues previous address to Döngö.
notes.manas-2010:p0178:b002:l033: най pipe/flute retained; folding/bending action across l033–034 opaque. Could name a commodity or instrument; no confident repair.
notes.manas-2010:p0178:b002:l035: Sart retained as source historical ethnosocial designation for the merchant group, not assigned a modern ethnicity.
notes.manas-2010:p0178:b002:l048: жабык tent eaves/covering used for hiding the slaughtered camel; precise placement uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0179:b002:l003: Raw Арымды means my honor rather than my nar. Rendered my nar as an explicit contextual emendation supported by p178:l046 and p179:l005 нарымдын; initial н may be absent in witness. Raw preserved; not an independent textual correction.
notes.manas-2010:p0179:b004:l021: Ash-beating idiom retained literally as threat of destroying hearth/home, not omitted.
notes.manas-2010:p0179:b004:l033: бардыгер all / total force, жинин каккыла rouse anger; exact idiom provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0180:b002:l015: каалады selected/chose, not merely wished; contextual troop selection.
notes.manas-2010:p0180:b002:l033: көй кашка an epithet of conspicuous excellence, tentatively renowned/outstanding; exact form uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0180:b002:l038: Эсепсиз literally uncountable/boundless, an awkward singular epithet for Döödür; retained without inventing a size.
notes.manas-2010:p0180:b002:l039: чолпон Venus/morning star in eye simile, not a named person.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l007: Forty foot-lengths retained without modern unit conversion; source does not explicitly establish diameter versus circumference, so across removed.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l014: казы horse-rib fat/meat retained; snow simile not explained away.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l016: chatyrash retained as a board-game name. Yudakhin calls it chess; 2015 dictionary describes a draughts-like game of fourteen white/fourteen black pieces. No modern rules imposed. https://el-sozduk.kg/ЧАТЫРА/
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l021: Кызыр standardized as Khizir (variant transliterations Kyzyr/Kydyr/Khizr); blessing idiom retained. Same p183:l008.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l028: Ок өтпөс literally shot-impervious; armor supplied from wearing in context, no real ballistic claim.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l032: No shot to exchange preserves paradox in the restless invulnerable hero formula; not a logistical ammunition shortage asserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l034: Зың-зың onomatopoeia retained zing-zing; humming is provisional action.
notes.manas-2010:p0181:b002:l038: Бучкак trouser-leg/edge idiom of contempt; literal image retained, not a comparison of physical sizes.
notes.manas-2010:p0182:b002:l005: оюн бекери idle game is tentative; visible wording not silently regularized.
notes.manas-2010:p0182:b002:l010: тамыр friends and ай exclamation inferred; Chalybay versus Manas as implied gathering subject remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0182:b002:l012: Black/white stepping interpreted foul/fair play in game context; literal colors not a racial reference.
notes.manas-2010:p0182:b002:l014: кадамак is an ordo phase/shot near the circle line, confirmed by Yudakhin and explanatory dictionaries with this passage. https://el-sozduk.kg/кадамак/
notes.manas-2010:p0182:b002:l016: тоорумак is an ordo shot; dictionary cites the next line entering the circle. https://el-sozduk.kg/ТООРУ/
notes.manas-2010:p0182:b002:l041: Two nar camels retained despite singular red nar at l044. No harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l001: Legible entire utterance remains uninterpreted; transliteration preserved privately in batch descriptor, not counted as English translation. Completion-first first pass: Low-confidence approximate rendering for “«Үттүгүңө шоодай», - деп,”; nearest corpus parallel was “«Көрүнөө кудай урду», - деп,”.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l009: Drawing the line retained literally, possibly game/battle metaphor; not an invented challenge speech.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l016: ок shot may be arrows or bullets in this mixed bow/gun martial diction; generic shot retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l026: Youngest of six lions retained as epic formula without identifying the six or rewriting genealogical chronology.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l030: укурук horse-catching pole metaphor preserved; exact кайрар construction provisional.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l040: Plural their necks/throats supplied from surrounding massacre; source uses singular possessed forms without named victim.
notes.manas-2010:p0183:b002:l046: талкан чалуу mixing ground grain: domestic-food simile retained in slaughter scene.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l003: All two hundred slaughtered retained despite Döödür surviving in l012. Draft records source contradiction, not reconciled fatality count.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l008: Red bucket of blood is a literal hyperbolic image, repeated l016; no volume inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l010: Жеткилең кирип аралап refers provisionally to Döödür entering the melee; precise subject and sequence uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l015: Visible full stop does not prevent fragment carrying into next line; English comma maintains readable syntax, raw punctuation unchanged.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l023: Unruliness and quarrels have no equal is contextual reading of жок чыгып; not literal absence of unruliness.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l028: чунак is a disparaging/affectionate wretch epithet here, not literal cropped ears asserted. Same l046.
notes.manas-2010:p0184:b002:l044: Ogoy retained as ancestor/protector name; shelter represents кара кылар, not a new living character introduced.

headings.en: Esenkan sends ten thousand troops under Joloy and Döngö to capture Manas

headings.raw: Манас Эсенкандын жиберген колунан эки жүз кишисин өлтүрүп, төөлөрүн жүгү менен талатканы
headings.en: Manas kills two hundred men from Esenkan’s army and has their camels and loads plundered

transcription_check.scope: All twenty pages rendered at 1600 pixels and visually inspected against source extraction. Two bold chapter headings separated. Raw source unchanged. This verifies the digital witness only, not archival transcription.

alignment_check.method: Read every Kyrgyz/English paired row in four five-page passes; checked per-page counts and corrected clause placement/lexical errors. Explicit ordered IDs include every non-heading, non-watermark display row.
